author: potuz
content: Oh I thought we moved it back to 600ms, at least that landed in develop I think. I'll check but yeah we made that configurable and default to something much shorter after measuring in devnet. For direct connection builders 600 ms is more than fine for most operators and if you live in the middle of Africa with a bad connection you can modify it. Also arguably the best strategy for an operator that wants to play timing games is not to  give a longer delay but rather request multiple times with a shorter one, so we'll make that configurable as well just in case
